chain_kill_popup: Box the large turquoise uppercase chain-kill announcement, such as “DOUBLE KILL,” including its dark rectangular background.
choose_landing_zone_banner: Box the bottom-center dark banner reading “CHOOSE A LANDING ZONE,” including the controls beneath it.
circle_number: Box the small circle number and countdown timer directly beneath the minimap in the upper-left corner.
death_banner: Box the lower-center KILLED BY banner containing the opponent's name, rank, emblem, and calling card.
down_banner: Box the upper-right enemy-down notification, including the medical icon, player name, red message, and emblem.
kill_banner: Box the eliminated player's horizontal calling-card banner near the bottom center, including its name and emblem.
killcam: Box the white KILLCAM text near the top center of the screen.
map: Box the minimap showing terrain and player markers in the upper-left corner.
plane_indicator: Box the large transport plane viewed from above in the center of the screen.
post_match_scoreboard: Box the large central post-match table showing player names, scores, eliminations, kills, assists, redeploys, damage, and squad totals.
red_down_msg: Box the small red ENEMY DOWN text inside the upper-right down notification.
red_kill_msg: Box the small red kill-count message, such as '12TH KILL,' beneath the bottom-center kill banner.
released_banner: Box the upper-center skull-and-chains banner with green arrows, “RELEASED!” text, and “REDEPLOYING” underneath.
spectating: Box the white SPECTATING text near the top center of the screen.
squad_scoreboard: Box the compact colored squad statistics and numbers in the upper-right corner.
weapon_board: Box the bottom-right HUD showing ammunition counts, weapon icons, and equipment.
wz_defeat: Box the large white placement text, such as 4TH PLACE, centered on the end-of-match screen.
wz_pre_deployment: Box the upper-center deployment countdown, including the 'Deployment will begin in' text and large number.
wz_victory: Box the large white VICTORY text centered on the end-of-match screen.
xp_notif: Box each small XP notification text, such as ENEMY DOWNED, REVENGE, HUNTER, or LONGSHOT, near the center-right.
